desc.zh: 从三个字母出发，证明旋转与排序之间的分界。
desc.en: Start with three letters and prove the boundary between rotation and sorting.

complexity: k = 1: O(n²) time; k ≥ 2: O(n log n) time; O(n) auxiliary space in both cases

concepts.name: Circular-order invariant
concepts.description: With k=1 every reachable string is a rotation.

concepts.name: Adjacent swaps and reachability
concepts.description: Positions one and two suffice to construct any adjacent swap.
